name: Antique Engraving
description: 18th/19th-century copperplate and steel engraving with fine black-ink cross-hatching and line work on aged cream paper. Pure black ink only with strictly no color, no sepia wash, no photographic look, and no torn edges.
system_instructions: Execute as an authentic 18th- or 19th-century copperplate or steel engraving: Fine black-ink cross-hatching, stippling, contour lines, and etched linework on aged cream or ivory laid paper. Crisp black ink line work defining depth, shadow, and architectural mass. STRICTLY NO color, NO sepia wash, NO watercolor, NO photographic shading or blur. STRICTLY NO torn paper edges or chipped borders (torn edges belong exclusively to century-old photograph style). Preserves period-accurate historical clothing, masonry, ships, machinery, weaponry, and authentic settings. Stills are held completely still with no zoom and no pan.
